title: Unit Event — Halt! Tenma's on the Case — Episode8 Heart, Technique, Strength

meta.Event Outline: At Kijima's suggestion, Tsukasa has been putting on muscle to increase his acting chops. He and the others arrive at the Jidaigeki Studio Park with the Mikazukigumi troupe, but news of a theft puts the new production on hold...and that's when Tsukasa spots a suspicious ninja on the lot!

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line:
“I'll give him that he's faster than us...
No wonder he's called the swift-footed thief.”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line: “You've been practicing that one technique in the evenings, right, Heihachi?”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line:
“Of course I knew.
How many years do you think we've been working together now?”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line:
“Use it against him, Heihachi!
That should allow us to catch Chusuke!”

rows.Speaker: Chusuke
rows.Line:
“Hah!
If you want to catch me, then you'll have to come up here!”

rows.Speaker: Chusuke
rows.Line: “But I'm guessing that you tortoises will never be able to. Not even in a million years!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, that was amazing...!!!
You're the coolest, Heihachi!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: He just glided up that wall!

rows.Speaker: Heihachi
rows.Line: “This is what you get for underestimating me! I am Heihachi, Mr. Ginnosuke's right-hand man!”

rows.Speaker: Heihachi
rows.Line: “We can't let you keep running amok forever! Prepare yourself!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Whoa...!!!
He caught him! That was awesome!!!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: He caught a grown man all by himself! He must be really strong...!!!

rows.Speaker: Chusuke
rows.Line:
“Grr...!
But I can't get caught! I'm THE Chusuke...”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line:
“Too bad for you, Chusuke.
Your legs were no match for me and Heihachi.”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line: “Now, Chusuke, it's time for us to tie you up!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That concludes our final showing...
Our time here really flew by.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nice work, Tsukasa.
You wowed us all again with your wall jumping today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And the audience got so excited!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! How spectacular was I?!
My portrayal of Heihachi was spot-on, was it not?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm glad that you got a chance to wall jump during the actual show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me too! We need to thank Mr. Kijima and the others again for being so accommodating.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Oh, nice work, all of you!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Your performance today was excellent!
All that sword fighting practice you did really paid off!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's because you and your troupe were such great teachers, Mr. Kijima! Thank you so much for everything!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I appreciate you saying that!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Also, did you hear?
They found out that thief's identity.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
A former cast member.
During his first visit back in a very long time, something came over him which caused him to steal a person's belongings he saw on the ground. Unfortunately, he succeeded in getting away with it.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: He soon realized that he could continue stealing things undetected if he masqueraded as a cast member playing a ninja.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
So that's why he seemed like a real ninja...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
It's such a shame.
Despite being so athletic, he decided to use his abilities for unwholesome purposes.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But I'm hoping that you'll all use your fitness for what you consider good.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Still, this is a sad moment.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: The end of this show means you're just about finished training with us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you again for everything you've done for us, Mr. Kijima.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We all learned quite a lot while training with Mikazukigumi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Most importantly, that an actor's physical fitness is their best asset. I think we all have a firm understanding of that now.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm glad that we were able to help you all.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But I also need to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Seeing you and Wonderlands×Showtime at work reminded me of how...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You need heart in order to make your dreams and ideals a reality.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Good fitness and technique.
Those are both things you need to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But there are times when just those aren't enough. You experienced that firsthand this time around, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: We want to move others and make them smile.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
That spirit motivates us.
It helps us keep moving forward even during the toughest of times.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Heart, technique and fitness.
Only when we've attained all three of those things can we start properly moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Seeing all of you reminded me of how I need to remain passionate. To keep that fire in my heart going.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Let's all keep doing our best!
To make our dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Now then!
Let's say goodbye to each other with a nice, big group hug!!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I couldn't have asked for better students!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I hope we get to perform together again someday! And keep those beautiful fires in your hearts going! Do your best with the next troupe you visit! Hah hah hah hah!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll see you later!
The other troupe members and I are getting a big farewell party ready for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Each day was pretty grueling, but I really learned a lot about my body and how to become more fit...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We always seem to learn so much whenever we visit someplace new.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's keep doing the same when we start training with the next troupe we visit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And the next one is going to be our last.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The largest musical theatre troupe in Japan. It's hard to believe that we get to train with them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We need to keep doing our best when we start training with them...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As sad as it is that we have to say goodbye to everybody from Mikazukigumi...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I want to see how I can apply what I learned with them in another environment.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, we'll be parting ways for now.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(If the trail ends, I'll blaze a new one.
And I will achieve my goal...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm going to become a star who makes the whole world smile...!!!)
